UpKeep is an asset operations management and CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) platform. The UpKeep API provides programmatic access to work orders, assets, parts, locations, preventive maintenance schedules, purchase orders, meters, and webhooks for maintenance teams and facility managers.
